question: Should OpenClaw adopt a quick-fix PR template alongside a fuller PR template for higher-risk changes?
rationale: The patch is small and technically aligned with GitHub's template mechanism, but it changes the repository's contributor intake policy and the linked issue is already labeled as needing a product decision.

options.title: Accept selectable templates
options.body: Land this PR after a current-base refresh if maintainers want the quick/full contributor workflow.

options.title: Keep one default template
options.body: Close or request withdrawal if maintainers want one canonical PR body for all contributor changes.

options.title: Narrow the quick template
options.body: Ask for one more revision if maintainers want the quick template to include additional visible sections such as User Impact or AI disclosure.

recommendation.title: Accept selectable templates
recommendation.body: Land this PR after a current-base refresh if maintainers want the quick/full contributor workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is repository-level contributor workflow policy, and `steipete` is both listed as top-level maintainer in `CONTRIBUTING.md` and tied to the merged proof-policy history.
